description: Operator-owned draft OCR helper for previewing menu text or photographed paper menus before catalog review.

public_catalog.function: Lets a restaurant operator preview OCR/scanned menu lines as draft catalog items before human review.
public_catalog.data_access_summary: Draft item ids, names, prices, categories, and OCR source lines. Operator-only; does not write catalog truth by itself.
public_catalog.operator_status: available in the pilot-node operator dashboard when enabled alongside the catalog editor
